title: Get the resident app
summary: Pay dues, approve visitors and raise requests from your phone.
steps: Ask the society office for the app link.
Install the app and sign in with your mobile number - the one the society has for you.
Choose your society and your flat.
Turn on notifications so you hear about visitors and notices.
more: In the app: see and pay your dues, approve visitors at the gate, raise and track requests, read notices, book amenities.

title: Moving in? Here's how
summary: A few steps before and on moving day.
steps: Tell the society office your flat number and moving date.
Owners: add your tenant or family in the app, or ask the office to add them.
Tenants: share your rental agreement and ID proof with the office.
Register your vehicles so the gate knows them.
Book the lift or loading area for moving day if the society asks for it.
Sign in to the resident app once you have been added.
more: Moving out later? Start it in the app or at the office, and clear your dues first.

title: Expecting a visitor?
summary: Let the gate know before they arrive.
steps: Pre-approve guests in the app; they get a code to show at the gate.
For a walk-in visitor, the guard asks you in the app - approve or decline.
Deliveries can be left at the gate when you are away.
Add your daily help once, so they come and go without a call.
more: In an emergency, use the SOS button in the app or call the security desk.

title: Something to fix?
summary: Raise a request in the app instead of waiting at the office.
steps: Open Help Desk in the app and raise a request; add a photo if it helps.
Choose the category - plumbing, electrical, lift, cleaning and more.
Track it: you are told when it is taken up and when it is done.
Rate the work once the request is closed.
more: Common areas too: report a broken light or a leak on any floor.
